validity.researcher_notes: This answers the length_ratio flag (drawn route 375 km vs LengthKnownKm 44 km, ratio 8.53) AND directly the source_ladder's question of whether P0934/P2746 'are split at the right point' — they are not, on the geometry axis specifically (the crosswalk's existing escalation is about the length/status VALUE split; this is about the ROUTE assignment). Measured directly from data/individual-routes/gas-pipelines/P0934.geojson (haversine over each vertex pair): the file holds THREE line pieces — (1) a degenerate zero-length point near Mangaluru (74.892E,12.862N, 3 identical vertices), (2) a genuine short Kochi-area line, 34.1 km, running 76.197E/10.059N → 76.314E/10.072N — geographically consistent with the real Phase I Kochi–Koottanad segment (though undershooting the ~41 km NS Energy reports for that segment, i.e. still a partial trace), and (3) a 342.4 km line running 76.237E/10.188N (Koottanad area) all the way north to 74.892E/12.862N — Mangaluru's latitude/longitude — which is geographically the Koottanad–Mangaluru BRANCH, not part of Kochi–Koottanad Phase I at all. Two independent sources place that Koottanad–Mangaluru branch under PHASE II, already substantially commissioned: nsenergybusiness.com dates its commissioning to June 2019 at ~440 km ('the 440km pipeline stretch...via Koottanad was successfully completed and commissioned in June 2019'), and psuwatch.com's April-2026 update gives essentially the same branch as 'Kochi to Mangaluru Section (450 km)...already commissioned and supplying to anchor customers' — as part of KKBMPL PHASE II, alongside a separate, still-partial 'Koottanad-Bengaluru Section'. So the ~342 km line drawn under P0934 (labelled Phase I / Kochi-only in the sheet) is geographically and operationally a Phase II segment, which is exactly why P0934 measures 375 km against a 44 km sheet value: it is carrying geometry that belongs to its sibling row. Correspondingly P2746 (Phase II, sheet value 1,060 km) measures only 384 km because its one drawn line (77.043E/12.784N → 76.004E/10.839N, i.e. running toward Bengaluru) is a partial trace of ONLY the Koottanad–Bengaluru branch — independently reported at 625 km (nsenergybusiness.com) to 901 km authorised (psuwatch.com's 2026 KKBMPL-II figure) — and does not include the Koottanad–Mangaluru branch at all. I am not proposing replacement coordinates myself, per protocol; this is a route-geometry finding for the human §8 pass, distinct from (and in addition to) the already-staged length/status VALUE escalation on this pair.
